answer_1.quote: ...We use a pre‑trained adversarially regularized autoencoder (ARAE) ... to generate natural attack triggers ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated text triggers (adversarial phrases) concatenated to benign inputs

answer_2.quote: ...We evaluate triggers using three simple defense metrics: word frequency, GPT‑2 loss, and grammar checkers (Scribens, Chegg)...

answer_4.quote: ...We performed a human‑subject study on Amazon Mechanical Turk, asking workers to compare the naturalness of our triggers vs baseline and to judge whether a piece of text is naturally generated...
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to select the more natural trigger and to determine if a text is naturally generated, with a "Not sure" option.
